title: WordGuessResponse v1
description: The model's guesses for one word, best first (ADR 0036). Swift: ArabiziContracts.WordGuessResponse. Explained in docs/API_CONTRACTS.md.

v.description: Contract version; anything else is rejected.

id.description: The id of the request this answers.

guesses.description: Arabic words, best first, each with the model's log-probability of writing it there.

outcome.description: model: the model answered (the list may be empty); fallbackTimeout: the deadline passed; fallbackModelUnavailable: no model.

latencyMs.description: Time from receiving the request to answering it.
